title: E-commerce Documentation
projImgAlt: E-commerce website designed to help customers grow their business
subtitle: E-Commerce That Scales With You
desc: Whether you're managing a small catalog or a large-scale storefront, this platform scales effortlessly with your business. Built for traffic surges, real-time inventory updates, and uninterrupted reliability, so your customers always enjoy a smooth shopping experience.

ProblemStat.title: Problem Statement
ProblemStat.text1: Businesses without an online store in Ghana are losing half their potential customers to competitors who go digital. Non-Ghanaians in Accra shop online regularly, but if your business isn't online, you're invisible to them
ProblemStat.text2: by making it easy for any business to launch a professional online store, no technical skills needed.

WhoExp.title: Who Experiences This Problem? (And Why It Matters)

ExpList: Limited resources for physical + online stores
No technical knowledge to build e-commerce sites
Too busy running the store, no time for digital growth
Can't sync store inventory with online systems
Data inconsistency between POS and e-commerce
Sales staff stuck handling online orders
Prefer digital convenience over traditional shopping
Can't track product availability across channels
Risk of overstocking or stockouts when unsynced
